scripts.speaker: Wandering Old Man
scripts.text:
...
I'm afraid you're not up for this yet.
You have to be at least Level 160.

scripts.speaker: Wandering Old Man
scripts.text: ...Where am I?

scripts.speaker: Wandering Old Man
scripts.text:
I don't know when it began...
The same nightmare has been plaguing me for a long time.

scripts.speaker: Wandering Old Man
scripts.text: In my nightmare, Demon King Morocc awakens from his century-long slumber and fills the world with darkness and horror.

scripts.speaker: Wandering Old Man
scripts.text: I couldn't shake off the vivid images I saw in that nightmare. I've wandered off and around like a madman and finally arrived here.

scripts.speaker: Wandering Old Man
scripts.text: I saw this place in my dream. It's where Demon God Morocc awakens from his slumber. My dream was showing me a possible future.

scripts.speaker: Wandering Old Man
scripts.text: If my dream really is a premonition, the forces of Demon God Morocc's are within that yellow seed.

scripts.speaker: Wandering Old Man
scripts.text: I tried to enter the seed, but to no avail: I'm just too old and weak. But perhaps you can.

scripts.speaker: Wandering Old Man
scripts.text:
Please investigate that yellow seed.
It's too dangerous for you to go alone. You should take at least one comrade with you.

scripts.speaker: Wandering Old Man
scripts.text:
Please investigate that yellow seed.

scripts.speaker: Vrid
scripts.text:
I came by
this Hero Token by accident.
I want to give it to you. You deserve it.

scripts.speaker: Vrid
scripts.text: Let's get out of this creepy place!
